name: Airstrike
description: Mark your aim for an aircraft bombing run.

name: Medic Drop
description: Drop medical supplies that restore nearby allies.

name: Shockwave
description: An expanding pulse throws nearby enemies backward.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: A cloud of smoke conceals your team from enemy aim.

name: Artillery Barrage
description: Multiple shells strike a targeted area.

name: Lightning Device
description: Electric arcs leap between nearby enemy soldiers.

name: Minefield
description: Deploy several proximity explosives around your line.

name: Flame Burst
description: An expanding ring of fire burns surrounding enemies.

name: Resistance Reinforcements
description: Summon temporary allied fighters to support the team.

name: Rocket Rain
description: A volley of guided missiles seeks nearby enemies.

name: Cluster Grenades
description: An explosive charge splits into several smaller blasts.

name: Bomber Squadron
description: A powerful sweeping aircraft attack crosses the battlefield.

name: Dashstep
description: Dash 260m along your aim with brief protection. Walls and locked gates still stop you.

name: Aegis Field
description: Create an eight-second barrier that absorbs damage equal to 70% of your maximum health plus 40.

name: Frost Nova
description: Freeze nearby ordinary enemies for two seconds. Bosses take damage and suffer a longer chill instead.

name: Gravity Well
description: Place a five-second field at your aim. It drags ordinary enemies inward and pulses damage; bosses resist the pull.

name: Mirror Ward
description: For four seconds, nearby hostile projectiles reflect back as your shots. Explosions and melee still threaten you.

name: Vital Siphon
description: Drain up to three enemies in your forward arc. Recover health equal to 30% of the actual damage dealt.

name: Venom Fan
description: Fire seven piercing needles in a fan. Hits build the same stacking poison used by venom weapons.

name: Overdrive
description: For six seconds your firearm recovers between shots 45% faster. Ammunition, reloads, and heat still matter.

name: Field Supply
description: Give each nearby standing hero 200 reserve rounds, one medkit, and two grenades.

name: Revival Beacon
description: Place a five-second medical beacon. It steadily heals allies and revives a fallen partner who stays within its field for two seconds.

name: Orbiting Blades
description: Four blades orbit you for eight seconds, cutting enemies they physically pass through. Position close to land repeated hits.

name: Grapple Hook
description: Hook an ordinary enemy in your aim and drag it toward you. The pull stops at cover; bosses cannot be dragged.

name: Frost Breath
rewardStatement: REWARD: Frost Breath — sweep a cone of biting cold across your foes, building frost until ordinary enemies freeze.
discoveryClue: Seek the lost reservoir expedition in Frostmarch. Its entrance requires the Rimeglass Valve Key, hidden elsewhere in Stonecrest.
description: Breathe three pulses through a 270-range cone: 18 base damage per pulse, plus hero level and Tactics scaling. Each pulse builds frost. Four frost hits freeze ordinary enemies for 1.1 seconds; bosses are chilled instead. Frozen targets resist another freeze for 4 seconds. Earned only from A Breath Beneath the Ice.

name: Aurora Well
rewardStatement: REWARD: Aurora Well — plant a four-second sanctuary that restores nearby heroes and allies while clearing the chill.
discoveryClue: Find the wayfinder who watches the wind-carved Zephyr Reliquary in Reedwater.
description: Create a 165-radius sanctuary for 4 seconds. Living heroes inside recover 6% maximum health each second, up to 24% total; nearby resistance allies recover at the same rate. Clears slowing chill while inside. Does not revive fallen allies, and overlapping wells do not stack. Earned only from The Wind Remembers.
